messages:
Alex G: Quick design review request for the API Keys detail modal. Trying a super-compact rotate UI — new key shown + small scope pills. Can folks scan copy & a11y?

Tori (PM): Short is good. Main thing: tell users this is shown once. Example lead: 'New key generated — copy now. This value will only be shown once.' then a link 'How to roll out' for details.

Ben (Design): Agree. Also proposing scope pills inline (max 3) with a 'View all' link to details. Keeps modal short.

Sam (A11y): A few notes: 1) Add visually-hidden text to the key value: 'New key value, shown only once'. 2) Make the copy button focusable and add aria-describedby referencing that hidden text. 3) For the 'View all' link, use aria-expanded on the reveal and ensure the revealed region has a heading.

Alex G: Nice. Another tiny thing: rotate modal currently has an "Allow overlap" checkbox. Customers expect a human-friendly label — propose 'Enable 30-minute overlap (recommended for gradual rollout)'. Default off.

Tori (PM): Keep the checkbox but add a tooltip explaining security tradeoffs. Also when enabled show a compact banner on the key details page: 'Overlap active — ends at 14:23 UTC'.

Sam (A11y): Tooltip must use role="tooltip" and be keyboard dismissible. Countdown shouldn't be the only indicator; include absolute end time and aria-live="polite" updates. Avoid rapid numeric flashing.

Ben (Design): For revoke, moving it from the kebab to a bottom danger panel seems to reduce support asks. Headline: 'Permanently revoke key' + checkbox 'I understand this will stop traffic' before enabling CTA.

Tori (PM): Action items: Ben update Figma with pills + compact copy; Sam to post checklist for the modals; Alex to prototype the overlap banner.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled 2026-03-24T17:00Z — includes key UI CSS changes.

Alex G: Thanks all — will ping for final pass once mocks are in. :thumbsup:
